zh-CN.title: 自测练习
zh-CN.goal: 把知识点变成有解释反馈的练习页面。

optionalInputs.question: 要检查哪些知识点或技能？
练习者的水平和难度偏好是什么？
是否有题库、答案或评分标准？
希望立即反馈还是完成后统一查看？

qualityChecks: 答案与解析必须一致，多选、未答和重试状态需明确。
题目没有唯一答案时用评分量表，不伪造精确分数或通过认证。
本地自测不要声称防作弊；收集班级成绩需明确受控分享和数据范围。
zh-CN.missingInformationPolicy: 所有问题均可跳过；使用已有资料，显式列出影响结果的假设，未知事实保留待确认。

en.title: Self-test practice
en.goal: Create practice with explanatory feedback for each learning objective.

optionalInputs.question: Which concepts or skills should the practice assess?
What is the learner’s level and desired difficulty?
Are questions, answers or grading criteria provided?
Should feedback appear immediately or after completion?

qualityChecks: Keep answers and explanations consistent; define multi-select, skipped and retry states.
Use a rubric for open-ended answers; do not invent precise grades or certifications.
Local practice does not prevent cheating; class results require an explicit controlled collection flow.
en.missingInformationPolicy: All questions may be skipped. Use known material, state consequential assumptions, and leave unknown facts unresolved.
